title: Scan Result
description: Normalized output of any deterministic scanner (stage 04_static_scan), before correlation into a candidate finding. This is evidence, not a conclusion -- see .claude/rules/security.md 'Scanner Trust Policy'.

raw_severity.description: The tool's own severity label, kept separate from this project's severity/priority -- never used directly without correlation.

correlated.description: Set true once security-reviewer has correlated this result with code/architecture context in 05_llm_review.

promoted_finding_id.description: Set if this scan result was promoted to a candidate finding; absent if discarded as noise.

raw_output.description: Original tool output, preserved for traceability.
